**In one line**: Dordt University in Iowa has started a generative AI pilot program that combines access to AI tools with structured campus conversations about using them.

### Key points
- Dordt University has introduced a generative AI pilot program on campus, according to Iowa Capital Dispatch.
- The effort reportedly goes beyond simply granting tool access, building in community discussions about how AI should be used in an academic setting.
- Pairing tool rollout with dialogue suggests a focus on establishing usage norms rather than adopting AI without guardrails.

### Why it matters
It's a single-school story, but the model of launching AI access and community discussion together — rather than "open the tools first, set the rules later" — offers a reference point for how other educational institutions might bring generative AI onto campus.
